content.title: FAQ | UFC
content.text: Frequently Asked Questions How Can I Get Tickets To A UFC Event? Tickets are generally released for an event a few months prior to the fight. To find Tickets to the next UFC event in your area, go to the Tickets section of UFC.com. . What Does The Upcoming Event Schedule Look Like? Please visit the Upcoming Events page for the most up-to-date schedule of events and fight cards on UFC.com. Are Pay-Per-View events included in UFC Fight Pass? No, Pay-Per-View events are sold on a standalone basis until they are made available a few months after the initial airing and become available within UFC Fight Pass. See the most recent full event replays inside of UFC Fight Pass at Event Replays If I purchased a UFC Fight Pass subscription within the UFC.TV application on my iPad or iPhone, can I view the videos on my computer and other devices? Yes. After FIGHT PASS has been purchased inside of the iPhone/iPad/iTouch application, the content is viewable on other devices by signing-in with your UFC.TV account inside of the application which will authenticate the purchase and extend access to other devices. How do I cancel my UFC FIGHT PASS subscription?Click on the “My Account” tab on the top of the UFC FIGHT PASS page. Once you are there, click on the “My Subscriptions” tab. Then Click “Cancel Subscription” and when asked to confirm click “Yes, Cancel Subscription.” You can resume access to UFC FIGHT PASS at any time, as long as your payment information is up to date. How do I contact Customer Support for UFC.TV or UFCFIGHTPASS.COM?Email Support@ufc.tv. with any issues regarding UFC.TV and devices. How Do I Access My UFC Fight Club Ticket Presale Code? Log on to the UFC Fight Club website. Then, click on the events tab and scroll down until you find your unique presale code. Each presale code will allow you to purchase a maximum of six tickets for an event. Pre-sale tickets are not guaranteed. How Can I Get A Job With The UFC? To join the greatest sports organization in the world, please visit our job board to see available openings and to submit your resume. How Do I Find More Information About The Next UFC Fan Expo? Visit the UFCFANEXPO.COM for more information on how to exhibit at a future UFC Fan Expo. Has UFC The Offcial Magazine Closed? Yes, after six incredible years of delivering exclusive content to UFC fans the Oct/Nov issue (on sale September 8, 2015) will be the final issue o fUFC: The Official MagazineClick Her for More FAQs Regarding the Closing. Where Can I Find A Local Bar Or Restaurant That Is Showing The Next UFC Event? Visit Bars.UFC.com to find a list of bars and restaurants that are showing the next UFC event in your area. When And Where Will The Next UFC Gym Open? Visit UFCGym.com for up-to-date information on UFC Gyms. HOW CAN I SUBMIT AN INQUIRY OR ISSUE REGARDING CLOSED CAPTIONING ON UFC.TV? Please provide a clear description of your concern and a way to get in contact with you, including: -Name of the program; -Type of issue (e.g., garbling, captions cut off at certain times or on certain episodes of certain programming; -Website or application where you viewed the programming -Approximate time and date that the issue occurred; and -Your name and contact information including mailing address, email, and phone number Send to: ccaptioning@ufc.comFor further details and contact information regarding closed captioning, please visit our closed captioning page .Contact UsBack to the top Find More Answers To Your Questions: UFC FIGHT PASS FAQ | UFC.TV FAQ | UFC STORE HELP | UFC FIGHT CLUB HELP
